title: Using the Renormalized Energy from Ginzburg-Landau Theory to Compute Solution Landscapes in the Reduced Landau-de Gennes Theory
summary: We study nematic liquid crystal phases confined to bounded, two-dimensional (2D) domains, in the reduced Landau-de Gennes (rLdG) theoretical framework. The rLdG framework is equivalent to the celebrated Ginzburg-Landau (GL) theoretical setting, under certain assumptions. In the asymptotic limit of large domains (or low temperatures), we recall the concept of the finite-dimensional renormalized energy in the GL theory [Bethuel et al., GL Vortices, Prog.
